knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Gutter work is work at height. It is within scope only where the scope and an authorised access method allow it, and otherwise it is recorded and referred.
Dust and debris from a blower are carried toward the car and the child. The method is stopped, the exposure is removed or the method changed, and work restarts only when the area is clear.
Mouldy, contaminated or unknown debris is outside routine clearance and must be referred.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied mock site with a driveway, a lawn and a gutter request, the learner marks the in-scope and excluded areas and records the referral for the gutter within the assessor's set time.
The learner selects the least dusty method for a supplied mock surface and explains the choice to the assessor.
The learner contains a supplied pile of mock debris on a tarp and moves it along a one-way route without debris entering the mock drain.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Annotated mock site plan with scope decisions, signed by the assessor.
Assessor observation record of the method choice and containment.
Referral record for the gutter request.
stopWorkCriteria: Use of a ladder or platform for the mock gutter during the assessment.
Any blower use that sends simulated debris toward a person or car in the mock site.
Debris entering the mock drain during the assessment.
